C08-M05-L05-F1.title: Classifying an alert: FP, benign TP, TP or undetermined
C08-M05-L05-F1.caption: Two questions, asked in order, separate a false positive from a benign true positive and a true positive, each with its own next action.
C08-M05-L05-F1.alt: Decision graph, top to bottom. An alert fired leads to a violet decision box: Did the rule match what it was written to detect? If no, the alert is a False positive (logic or data error), which leads to Close and raise a tuning ticket. If yes, a second violet decision box asks: Is the activity authorised, with evidence? If yes with a change or ticket reference, it is a Benign true positive, which leads to Close with the reference and consider a scoped suppression. If no, it is a True positive, which leads to Investigate or escalate. If the evidence is insufficient to answer either question, the alert is Undetermined, which leads to Record the gap and keep open or escalate.

nodes.label: Did the rule match its intent?
nodes.sub: what it was written to detect

C08-M05-L05-F1.note: Authorisation must be proven by a record, never assumed from who the user is.

C08-M05-L05-F2.title: Scoped suppression versus over-suppression in the lab
C08-M05-L05-F2.caption: The same R3 rule run in a temporary copy of the kit with the kit's narrow suppression, and with an added host-wide one.
C08-M05-L05-F2.alt: Comparison of two columns separated by vs. Left, green, Scoped: user = itadmin: entry R3, user, itadmin, reason CHG-1042, expiry 2026-12-31; suppresses only the BLD-01 build_runner event; both WS-104 svc_update alerts still queued at 5.4; owner, reason and expiry recorded. Right, red, Over-suppressed: host = WS-104: entry R3, host, WS-104, reason too noisy, no expiry; suppresses all three R3 events; the attacker's svc_update admin account disappears; no owner, no ticket, never expires.

columns.title: Over-suppressed: host = WS-104
items: No owner, no ticket, never expires

C08-M05-L05-F2.note: A suppression should be as narrow as the benign pattern it describes, and no wider.
